jobs.description:
The company is located in Brussels.

Jobomschrijving

As a Finance Officer your responsibilities are:

• Manage daily financial transactions and maintain accurate records.
• Prepare and review financial statements and reports.
• Ensure compliance with financial regulations and standards.
• Support month-end and year-end financial closing processes.
• Collaborate with internal teams to manage budgets and forecasts.
• Monitor accounts payable and receivable processes.
• Assist in audits and implement recommendations as required.
• Provide financial analysis and insights to support decision-making.

A successful Finance Officer should have:

• Educational background in accounting, finance, or a related field.
• Residence in Brussels/Belgium.
• Valid EU work permit.
• Proficiency in financial software and tools.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Attention to detail and accuracy in financial reporting.
• Ability to communicate effectively in both English and French.

We are urgently seeking a dedicated Melting Furnace Operator for a leading company in the metal industry.

 

As a Melting Furnace Operator, you play a crucial role in the melting process. You ensure a smooth supply of raw materials and guarantee high levels of quality and safety.

• You accurately weigh the prescribed quantities of raw materials and load them into the melting furnace.
• You follow the production schedule and program the production sequences for optimal productivity.
• You work according to the standard operating procedures and the instructions of the shift leader.
• You participate in 5S and problem-solving events to optimize the process.
• You are responsible for the cleanliness of your work area.
• If necessary, you operate related equipment such as a bulldozer, forklift, and power tools.

Your profile as melting furnace operator; 

• You have industrial experience.
• You are able to work well both independently and as part of a team, even under time pressure.
• You have strong mechanical skills and are comfortable using hand tools. Basic knowledge of power tools, forklifts, and bulldozers is a plus.
• You have an eye for detail and deliver precise, high-quality work.
• You are eager to learn and always open to acquiring new skills.
• Working safely is second nature to you, and you strictly follow all procedures.
• You speak perfect English and French or Dutch and English

Your responsibilities 
 

You will provide comprehensive administrative and organisational support to our lawyers.
 

Your responsibilities will include:
 

Matter and document support: opening and maintaining matters in the ERP system; preparing court documents; finalising submissions; monitoring deadlines; ensuring consistent document formatting. Financial administration: preparing and following up invoices; creating purchase requisitions and purchase orders; processing expense reports. Planning and logistics: managing calendars; organising internal and external meetings; arranging travel; coordinating hearing-related logistics. Data and compliance: maintaining CRM records and monitoring lawyers’ professional or bar-related obligations.

Essential
 

At least two years’ experience in an administrative, executive assistant or management assistant role. Excellent written and spoken Dutch and English. Proficiency in Microsoft Office. Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities.  Desirable
 

Previous experience in a law firm or another professional-services environment. Working knowledge of French. Experience with ERP, document management or CRM systems.

We are looking for an enthusiastic sorting assistant for a company in Zulte that specializes in sorting and distributing clothing!

We are looking for a motivated sorting assistant to join our team.

In this position, you will be responsible for sorting various materials and processing them correctly.

What will you be doing?

• Sorting second-hand clothing into different qualities.
• Working at a good pace – you are dynamic and accurate.
• No allergies to dust and no physical complaints.
• You preferably live nearby or you have a car

What are our expectations?

• Knowledge of Dutch or English is required.
• Willingness to perform physical work.
• You are not allergic to dust!
• You are not colourblind!
• Accuracy and attention to detail.
• You are looking for a long-term job.
• You live close to Zulte or you have a car
• You are motivated and enjoy working in a team.

Our client is active in the service industry.

Jobomschrijving

 Your responsabilities will be : 
 
* Manage incoming emails and correspondence
 * Monitor and coordinate client bookings
 * Ensure the administrative follow-up of a portfolio of many clients
 * Organize travel, accommodation, and other arrangements for clients
 * Provide support to a diverse range of businesses and industries
 * Assist with management and executive support tasks
 * Provide reception back-up and front-office support
 * Handle various administrative and organizational duties

• Proficient knowledge of English and French required (Dutch is a plus)
• Ability to manage multiple priorities
• Service-minded attitude
• Experience in front desk operations and administration
• Passion for working in a premium hospitality environment
• Adaptable and flexible
• Strong dedication and reliability

Our client is a leading player in the financial services sector, known for its strong customer orientation, professional development opportunities, and collaborative culture. The company invests heavily in its employees and offers a stable environment where talent can grow and develop.

Jobomschrijving

• Build and maintain strong relationships with customers.
• Advise clients on products and services that match their needs.
• Support customers throughout their journey and provide excellent service.
• Identify commercial opportunities and contribute to business growth.
• Work closely with colleagues to ensure an outstanding customer experience.
• Participate in client meetings, follow-ups, and sales initiatives.

• Master's degree (field of study is not important).
• Fluent in French, Dutch, and English.
• Strong communication and interpersonal skills.
• Commercial mindset with a genuine interest in sales and customer relationships.
• Proactive, dynamic, and eager to learn.
• Team player with a positive attitude.

Are you ready to take your career in offset printing to the next level? We are seeking a skilled Offset Printer to ensure our high-quality standards are met in every print run. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a team that values precision, efficiency, and teamwork.

In this role, your day will start by setting up and operating our state-of-the-art offset printing machines. You will be responsible for maintaining the printers, ensuring consistent quality, and troubleshooting any issues that arise during the production process. Collaboration is key as you'll work alongside other professionals to meet production goals and deadlines.

If you're passionate about printing and looking for a role where your contributions are valued, apply now! Join us and become an integral part of a workplace that offers growth and learning opportunities.

• At least 2-3 years of experience as an offset printer
• Technical qualifications in printing at A2/A3 level or equivalent experience
• Experience in multi-color offset printing; experience in printing on solid board or CBA is an additional advantage
• Team player with strong communication skills and the ability to maintain a collaborative work environment
• Attention to detail with an excellent sense of quality and safety
• Communicative knowledge of English or Dutch

Our client is seeking an experienced Customer Service Manager to oversee customer service operations, drive continuous improvement, and lead a high-performing team.

Jobomschrijving

As a Customer Service Manager your responsibilities are:

• Lead and manage the customer service team to ensure high performance and efficiency.
• Develop and implement strategies to enhance customer satisfaction and loyalty.
• Monitor and improve operational processes to ensure seamless service delivery.
• Handle escalated customer issues and provide effective resolutions.
• Analyse customer feedback and data to identify areas for improvement.
• Ensure compliance with company policies and industry standards.
• Collaborate with other departments to align customer service goals with overall business objectives.
• Prepare and present reports on customer service performance to senior management.

A successful Customer Service Manager should have:

• Master's degree or equivalent higher education qualification
• Minimum 10 years of experience within an industrial or manufacturing environment
• At least 5 years of leadership experience in Customer Service, Supply Chain, Commercial Operations or Business Management
• Fluent in Dutch, French and English 
• Experience in exposure to executive leadership and cross-functional decision-making

• Strong background in change management and organizational transformation
• Experience working in complex international B2B environments

Leading a team of three, you will ensure the smooth running of the procure-to-pay cycle, support internal stakeholders and drive continuous improvements that contribute to stronger controls and faster supplier payments.

Jobomschrijving

In this role, you will manage the purchase order administration function and ensure the quality, accuracy and efficiency of related financial processes.

• Lead and support a team of three responsible for purchase order administration activities.
• Ensure purchase orders are created accurately and processed in line with internal procedures.
• Oversee supplier master data management, ensuring vendor information and bank details remain accurate and compliant.
• Maintain product catalogues and ensure pricing, descriptions and accounting information are up to date.
• Act as a key support partner for internal stakeholders, providing guidance on purchase order and supplier administration processes.
• Ensure compliance with approval workflows, financial controls and procure-to-pay procedures.
• Drive process improvements that enhance efficiency and support faster supplier payments.

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or equivalent experience.
• Proven experience in Accounts Payable, Accounting, Finance Operations or a similar environment.
• Fluent in English and either Dutch or French.
• Experience leading a team, or the ambition to take the next step from Team Lead to Manager.
• Strong understanding of procure-to-pay processes, purchase orders and supplier data management.
• Hands-on SAP experience is essential.
• A structured and detail-oriented professional with a strong focus on accuracy, controls and process efficiency.

Our client is the European subsidiary of a global leader in advanced alloys used in high-specification industries such as aerospace, medical, and energy.
The European headquarters hosts a truly multicultural team within a friendly, people-focused environment that combines the stability of a world-class manufacturer with the agility of a rapidly scaling organisation.
 
With ambitious growth plans across Europe and an exponentially expanding customer base, the company offers significant long-term career opportunities, internal mobility prospects, and the chance to contribute to a business positioned at the forefront of technical innovation.

Jobomschrijving

While full technical training is provided, your mission will be to ensure an excellent commercial experience for European customers and supporting the full sales cycle:

• Act as the main point of contact for customers in your assigned region, ensuring accurate verbal and written communication of all requirements.
• Manage inquiries, quotations, and orders, and coordinate with production, logistics, and technical teams across Europe and the U.S.
• Organise shipments of finished goods to European customers and follow up proactively on delivery status.
• Maintain and monitor inventory levels (general, custom, and market stock) and provide recommendations to management.
• Navigate strict quality, export compliance, and internal process requirements linked to aerospace-grade products.
• Solve day-to-day issues independently, escalating only when needed.
• Participate in weekly team meetings, one-to-ones, and ongoing coaching sessions with a dedicated local trainer.
• Contribute to continuous improvement and special internal projects.

The client is not looking for someone who has done this job before, but for a high-potential personality eager to grow, learn, and take ownership. 
Personality & Attitude :

• Ambitious, eager to accelerate their career and take on more responsibility over time (leadership, global exposure, or project ownership).
• Intellectually agile, quick to absorb large amounts of technical information.
• Exceptionally organised and structured, able to prioritise in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment.
• Assertive and confident on the phone, someone who proactively calls stakeholders rather than relying on emails.
• Open-minded, positive, and energetic, with strong resilience and stress resistance.
• Solution-oriented, able to anticipate issues and think ahead (plan B mindset).
• Comfortable dealing with demanding or high-level stakeholders, including U.S.-based teams.
Background & Experience :

The company welcomes talent from diverse sectors or any environment requiring:

• High customer interaction
• Complex coordination
• Strong communication & reactivity
Technical & Language Skills :

• Fluent in English (C-level) is mandatory
• At least B2 level in Turkish is required for customer interactions
• Affinity with technical topics, curiosity and willingness to learn about complex products

As a Recruitment Consultant, you will operate as a true 360° consultant, managing both client relationships and candidate processes. This role combines recruitment expertise with a strong commercial focus and offers the opportunity to develop your own market and portfol

Client Details

Michael Page is a globally recognised recruitment consultancy specialising in the placement of qualified professionals and managers across a wide range of sectors, including Finance, Human Resources, Sales & Marketing, Engineering, Supply Chain, Digital & Technology, Legal, and more.

As part of our continued growth in Belgium, we are looking for ambitious and driven individuals to join our Brussels office and contribute to our success while building their own professional career.

Description

Business Development & Sales

• Identify and prospect new business opportunities within your market.
• Develop and manage a portfolio of clients across different industries.
• Conduct client meetings to understand hiring needs and business challenges.
• Negotiate commercial agreements and recruitment partnerships.
• Build long-term relationships with key decision-makers and HR stakeholders.
• Become a trusted advisor for your clients regarding talent acquisition and market trends.

Recruitment & Talent Acquisition

• Manage the full recruitment lifecycle from briefing to placement.
• Source and engage top talent through LinkedIn, job boards, networking, and referrals.
• Conduct interviews and assess candidates' skills, experience, and motivations.
• Present qualified candidates to clients and manage the interview process.
• Deliver an exceptional candidate experience throughout the recruitment journey.
• Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline within your specialisation.

Client Relationship Management

• Act as the main point of contact for your clients.
• Provide market insights and salary benchmarking.
• Ensure a high level of service and client satisfaction.
• Develop long-term partnerships based on trust and expertise.
 

• Previous experience in sales, business development, recruitment, consulting, customer service, or a commercial role.
• Strong interest in business development and client relationship management.
• Entrepreneurial mindset and passion for achieving results.
• Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
• Resilient, ambitious, and motivated by targets and performance.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
• Fluent in French and English or Dutch and English.
• Fluency in French, Dutch, and English is considered a significant advantage.

Digital Printer-  2 shifts 

FUNCTIE OMSCHRIJVING

• Setting up and operating digital printing presses for labels and packaging 
• Monitoring print quality, colors, and finishing details 
• Preparing print files and production materials 
• Performing minor technical adjustments and machine maintenance 
• Following production schedules and meeting deadlines 
• Collaborating with production and finishing teams 
• Troubleshooting minor issues during the printing process 
• Maintaining a clean and safe working environment

PROFIEL
• English or Dutch
• Experience required
• Willing to work in 2 shifts

AANBOD

What is offered?

• Full-time position in a growing company
• Permanent contract after a successful interim period
• Attractive salary with extra legal benefits
• Internal training provided

jobs.occupation: Account Receivable & Credit Officer - Brussels - Food Sector
jobs.description:
Our client is a family-founded multinational company, leader in the global packaged goods industry, known for producing high-quality consumer products. Originating in Europe, the company has expanded its footprint to over a hundred countries, maintaining a strong presence in both mature and emerging markets.

Jobomschrijving

• Verification and recording of accounts receivable data
• Processing of incoming payments
• Compliance with group financial policies and procedures
• Preparation of invoices 
• Management of bank deposits
• Following up with clients to facilitate invoice payments
• Regular communication with clients
• Financial data analysis and report creation
• Monitoring credit-related performance indicators (KPIs)
• Implementation of action plans to ensure the company's financial health

• Minimum 3 years of experience as an A/R Officer or in a similar role
• Trilingual proficiency in Dutch, French, and English, enabling effective communication with diverse stakeholders
• High accuracy and attention to detail in work, especially in record-keeping
• Strong critical thinking skills to support precise and efficient operations
• Proficient in Excel and SAP, with hands-on technical knowledge
• Proactive problem-solver, addressing technical challenges with practical solutions
• Solid experience in credit collection and understanding of its accounting complexities
• Valuable contributor to effective management of accounts receivables

Our client is a well-established international organisation based in Brussels, bringing together professionals and stakeholders from across Europe. Operating in a dynamic and multicultural environment, the organisation plays a key role in supporting collaboration, policy development and industry best practices on an international scale.

With employees and members from numerous countries, the organisation offers a collaborative workplace where professionalism, continuous improvement and teamwork are highly valued.

Jobomschrijving

• Welcome visitors and act as the main point of contact for employees, guests and external partners.
• Ensure the office remains operational, organised and ready for daily business activities.
• Coordinate meeting rooms, prepare meeting spaces and support internal events and workshops.
• Manage office supplies, catering services, incoming and outgoing mail, and document archiving.
• Liaise with external suppliers and service providers to ensure smooth facility operations.
• Coordinate preventive and corrective maintenance of building systems and office equipment.
• Support workspace optimisation projects, including storage and inventory management.
• Contribute to creating a professional, safe and pleasant working environment for all employees and visitors.

• Secondary education diploma or equivalent experience.
• Initial experience (1 to 3 years) in office coordination, workplace services, hospitality, reception or administrative support.
• Comfortable working with Microsoft Office tools.
• Excellent communication skills in English, combined with a good knowledge of either French or Dutch. Knowledge of both is a strong asset.
• Customer-oriented and proactive mindset with a strong sense of service.
• Organised and detail-oriented, capable of managing multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Reliable, discreet and able to work autonomously while remaining a true team player.
• Available to work on-site on a full-time basis.

jobs.occupation: Customer Service Officer English-German-Dutch – Day Shift
jobs.description:
As a Customer Service Officer, you’ll be part of a multicultural, multilingual support platform. Every day, our team ensures that our customers’ vehicles and trucks are back on the road as quickly as possible. You’ll work in a close-knit team with the support of a team leader and helpful colleagues. You’ll meet new people with unique backgrounds and stories, and you’ll have the opportunity to learn new things daily.

Your key responsibilities include handling incoming phone calls and emails, responding to customer queries and liaising with third parties. You’ll gather and verify information for accuracy and completeness, provide technical support, and communicate with service workshops. Keeping customers and all stakeholders informed is essential, as is monitoring and managing agreements with all parties. You’ll also follow up on all contract-related matters within set deadlines. The core working schedule is Monday to Friday, with flexibility to work Saturdays during busy periods. Shifts are rotated between 7:00 AM and 10:00 PM.

An average day will see you juggling multiple customer queries, coordinating with technical teams, ensuring accurate and timely communication, and resolving any issues that may come up. You’ll need to multitask, prioritize tasks, and maintain a high standard of accuracy and customer service.

If you’re ready to take on a fast-paced, varied role in a supportive and international environment, apply now and start your journey in customer service!

• Professional bachelor’s degree or higher secondary education

• Excellent spoken English, good German and Dutch language skills

• Proficient in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, Outlook)

• Strong verbal communication skills, analytical and problem-solving ability

• Customer-oriented, results-driven, accurate, and able to multitask under pressure

• Technical knowledge (automotive, tires, etc.) is a plus, but not required

• No specific work experience required; open to juniors and starters

• Able to work shifts between 7:00 AM and 10:00 PM, Monday to Friday, with occasional Saturdays

About the Company

Our client is a leading logistics partner for the frozen food sector, serving industries, retailers, and foodservice companies. The company offers specialized frozen storage, inventory management, and logistics solutions, and is known for its stable operations, strong growth, and focus on employee wellbeing.

Jobomschrijving

Are you a hands-on person who enjoys physical work and thrives in a dynamic warehouse environment? Are you accurate, motivated, and not afraid of working in cold temperatures? Then this opportunity is for you!

For a stable and international logistics company in Oostkamp, specialized in frozen food storage and distribution, we are looking for motivated Order Pickers to strengthen the team.

Your tasks include:
	
• Picking orders using a voice-picking system or scanner	
• Checking products for quality and quantity	
• Preparing orders for shipment	
• Operating a standing Electric Pallet Truck (EPT)	
• Handling goods in a frozen warehouse environment (-22°C)

We are looking for candidates who:
	
• Have experience as an Order Picker 	
• Have experience operating an Electric Pallet Truck (EPT)	
• Are physically fit and enjoy active work	
• Work accurately and follow instructions carefully	
• Speak English or Dutch	
• Are reliable, motivated, and looking for long-term employment	
• Are comfortable working in a frozen environment (-22°C)

For a family-run company in the tyre sector, we are looking for an experienced tyre fitter to join the branch in Destelbergen.

Our client works for cars, trucks, agriculture and industry, and runs several branches across Belgium.

Hoe ziet jouw takenpakket eruit?
 
• You fit, repair and balance tyres. Plenty of trucks and agricultural vehicles, so proper work with heavy equipment. 
• You work cleanly and safely. A wheel that is not perfectly secured is never an option. 
• You step in wherever you are needed. In a small team, everyone pitches in. 
• After six months to a year, once you know the job inside out, you also join roadside call-outs. The employer pays for the training and your category C licence.
 
• Experience as a tyre fitter. By far the most important point on this list. 
• A category B driving licence. 
• Dutch or English is enough. If French is your main language, we do need a basic level of English on top of it so you can work smoothly with the team. No need to be fluent. 
• Someone who is punctual, gets stuck in and takes safety seriously. 
• The ambition to build something long term with one employer.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Diagnose and troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, and electronic issues in trucks

• 
Perform maintenance and repairs, including oil and filter changes, brake installation and bleeding, and component replacements

• 
Handle each assigned vehicle from A to Z, ensuring all required tasks are completed efficiently and accurately

• 
Document all work performed in line with company procedures

• 
Follow established time standards, safety guidelines, and quality requirements

• 
Cooperate with the workshop team and report to the workshop supervisor

• 
Education: Technical qualification or vocational training in truck mechanics or equivalent

• 
Experience: Minimum 3 years of relevant experience as a truck technician or diagnostic mechanic

• 
Driving licence: Category B required (C is an advantage)

• 
Languages: Basic communication skills in English or French

• 
Availability: Occasional on-call duty (once per month); no standard weekend work

Key Competencies

• 
Strong problem-solving ability and technical insight

• 
Team player with a proactive and reliable work attitude

• 
Adheres to safety standards and consistently uses PPE

• 
Open communicator, direct and honest in feedback

• 
Motivated to develop and grow within a professional workshop environment

Are you looking for a meaningful job where you contribute daily to improving the lives of patients with life-threatening diseases? As a Lab Technician you will work with a passionate team to develop groundbreaking therapies and make a real difference for patients worldwide.
 

Your key responsibilities:
 

 
• Work daily in a Class A/B/C/D cleanroom environment and maintain the cleanliness of equipment and facilities.
 
• Produce clinical and commercial ATMPs through aseptic manual processes, including cell isolation, selection, activation, transduction, culture, filling & finishing, and cryopreservation.
 
• Perform in-process control tests on batch samples, ensuring high standards for cell counts and viability.
 
• Ensure equipment operates smoothly by following instructions, troubleshooting issues, and coordinating repairs.
 
• Contribute to process optimization, including the introduction of new products, procedures, and equipment in GMP areas.
 
• Support the writing and review of SOPs and other production-related documents, and manage raw materials, consumables, and waste. 

Who we are looking for:
 

 
• You have obtained a Bachelor's degree in Sciences, Bio-Engineering, Biotechnology, Pharmacy, or a related field, or possess equivalent experience.
 
• Cell culture experience (internship or work-based) is a strong plus. 
 
• Knowledge of GMP regulations is a strong plus.
 
• Strong interpersonal skills with a focus on teamwork are required.
 
• Clear communication in English with attention to detail.
 
• Strong problem-solving abilities with a positive attitude.
 
• Motivated to learn independently and coach others.
 
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office applications.
